method: Season-to-date team offensive/defensive points per possession and pace; team ratings shrunk toward the prior league environment with prior strength 8; 2-point home-court margin split +1/-1 so it does not alter game total; same-day outcomes withheld.
limitations: The holdout is a team-only season-to-date replay; historical pregame injury and player-impact snapshots are unavailable.
Historical DraftKings full-game totals and paired executable prices are not in this free source; ROI and CLV are not measured.
The live app adds current injury, rest and travel adjustments; those inputs are not replayed in this historical team-form test.
